title: Minuta 2025-03-27
summary: The minutes of the 27 March meeting confirm a unanimous 50bp cut to 9.00% and the guidance to consider further adjustments of similar magnitude, and four of the five members individually back that path: one says the ex-ante real rate (5.6%, two points above the top of the neutral range) leaves room to keep calibrating, another finds it plausible to cut by the same amount at the next meeting, and the majority says downside risks to inflation have gained relevance as activity contracts, slack widens and the labor market cools. Versus the February minutes, which showed a split Board with a dissent against the faster pace, the Board has coalesced around 50bp moves. The minutes are nonetheless slightly less dovish than the unanimous communique: one member warns that the space for easing may be smaller ahead, that policy cannot be loosened as much as the market prices if inflation stalls near current levels, that the rate differential with the US cannot eventually fall far below its historical average, and asks that guidance stress taking new information 'sin premura y con cautela'. That lone note of caution keeps the minutes half a point above the communique.

key_quotes.quote: es plausible que en la siguiente reunión pudiera implementarse un recorte de igual magnitud.
key_quotes.context: One member sees another 50bp cut as plausible at the next meeting

key_quotes.quote: Sin embargo, la mayoría indicó que los riesgos a la baja han cobrado relevancia. Agregó que esto último obedece a la pérdida de dinamismo de la actividad económica.
key_quotes.context: Majority sees downside inflation risks gaining weight on weak activity

key_quotes.quote: Estimó que el espacio para el relajamiento de la postura monetaria podría ser menor hacia delante.
key_quotes.context: The lone cautious member: room to ease may narrow

key_quotes.quote: la tasa real ex ante se ubicó en un nivel de 5.6%, aún visiblemente por encima del intervalo de neutralidad de 1.8 a 3.6%.
key_quotes.context: Stance judged clearly restrictive, room to keep cutting
